Big changes often begin with small, consistent steps. Being kind to yourself is the first requirement of this journey.

## Start small

Instead of trying to change everything in one day, pick just one thing today: a five-minute walk, a glass of water, a short breathing exercise.

## Consistency matters more than intensity

A small behavior repeated every day gives more lasting results than a big effort made once a month.

The mind affects the body <cite data-refs="ray2004">(Ray, 2004)</cite>. <cite data-refs="smith2010" data-narrative>Smith and Lee (2010)</cite> recommend small steps; both can be read together <cite data-refs="ray2004;smith2010~p~34">(Ray, 2004; Smith & Lee, 2010, p. 34)</cite>.
